results.title: OpenAI CEO announces new AI agent and avoids mention of security concerns at developer conference
results.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman introduced a “remarkably capable, always-on” artificial intelligence agent at an appearance Tuesday where he avoided any reference to security concerns around the company's most advanced models.
